title: input: add url_hints binding action
body:
Labels every link in the viewport with a short key sequence, similar to Alacritty's hints. Typing a label acts on that link; escape cancels and backspace undoes a key. Hint mode is modal and swallows other keys.

The action takes a mode: `open`, `persist` (stay in hint mode after opening), or `copy` (copy the link to the clipboard). The label alphabet and colors are configurable via `hint-alphabet` and the `hint-*` color options.

Hint mode ends on wheel scroll or a config reload, since the labels would no longer line up with the text. A hint-alphabet with duplicate or non-printable characters is rejected with a warning.

Labels are drawn into the renderer's copy of the cells so clearing them just dirties the terminal.

files.patch:
@@ -1465,6 +1465,18 @@ scrollbar: Scrollbar = .system,
 /// TODO: This can't currently be set!
 link: RepeatableLink = .{},
 
+/// The keys used to label links for the `url_hints` keybind action. Each
+/// character must be unique ASCII. One-key labels are used when there are
+/// no more links than characters, otherwise two-key labels.
+@"hint-alphabet": [:0]const u8 = "jfkdls;ahgurieowncmvtyqpzbx",
+
+/// Colors of the labels drawn by `url_hints`, and of the part of a label
+/// that has already been typed.
+@"hint-foreground": Color = .{ .r = 0x1d, .g = 0x1f, .b = 0x21 },
+@"hint-background": Color = .{ .r = 0xe9, .g = 0xff, .b = 0x5e },
+@"hint-typed-foreground": Color = .{ .r = 0xe9, .g = 0xff, .b = 0x5e },
+@"hint-typed-background": Color = .{ .r = 0x1d, .g = 0x1f, .b = 0x21 },
+
 /// Enable URL matching. URLs are matched on hover with control (Linux) or
 /// command (macOS) pressed and open using the default system application for
 /// the linked URL.

@@ -552,6 +552,24 @@ fn actionCommands(action: Action.Key) []const Command {
             .description = i18n.N_("Toggle read-only mode for the current surface."),
         }},
 
+        .url_hints => comptime &.{
+            .{
+                .action = .{ .url_hints = .open },
+                .title = i18n.N_("Open Link Hints"),
+                .description = i18n.N_("Label visible links so one can be opened with the keyboard."),
+            },
+            .{
+                .action = .{ .url_hints = .persist },
+                .title = i18n.N_("Open Link Hints (Keep Open)"),
+                .description = i18n.N_("Label visible links and stay in hint mode after opening one."),
+            },
+            .{
+                .action = .{ .url_hints = .copy },
+                .title = i18n.N_("Copy Link Hints"),
+                .description = i18n.N_("Label visible links so one can be copied with the keyboard."),
+            },
+        },
+
